name: I Was Seen as the Weakest Hero But I Can Secretly Edit the Metadata of the World?!?
summary: I Was Seen as the Weakest Hero But I Can Secretly Edit the Metadata of the World?!? is a minimalist word-editing game where players trim sentences down to their essentials while keeping them grammatically correct. Each scene presents a short paragraph, and your goal is to remove words until the sentence fits a strict word count, though the real challenge lies in how those omissions reshape the story. With absurd twists like bribing a horse, the game rewards creative editing, letting you craft wildly different outcomes from the same starting text.
